Georgia May on Instagram: "Sticky Chicken, Gochujang & Coconut Broth on Sticky Rice.

Serves 2
646kcals
41.2g protein 

Ingredients 
- 1 red onion 
- 2 cloves garlic 
- 20g ginger 
- 2 tbsp gochugang 
- 1.5 tbsp honey 
- 500 ml stock 
- 1 tin coconut milk 
- 2 tsp fish sauce 

Chicken 
- 2 chicken breast 
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 2 tbsp honey 
- 1 tsp chilli crunch oil

Garnish 
- Bok choy, sliced lengthways 
- Spring onion, finely sliced 
- Crispy onions 
- Chilli oil 
- Lime 
- Sesame seeds 

Mix the 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey and chilli crunch in a bowl, add the chicken breasts mix and leave to marinate while you make the broth. 

Finely slice the onion, dice the ginger and garlic. Take a saucepan with a little oil on a medium high heat, add the onion and cook for around five minutes until soft and translucent. Now at the ginger and garlic and cook for another couple of minutes. Turn the heat down slightly and add the honey and Gochujang paste and cook for 1 minute constantly stirring. Now add the stock and coconut milk, mix well and turn the heat down to a gentle simmer. 

Take a frying pan on a medium high heat and add a little oil. Add the chicken breasts and cook for around 5 minutes each side until cooked through. Now add the remaining of the chicken marinade and allow it to bubble, reduce and turn Sticky. Flip the chicken a couple of times to fully coat the chicken in the delicious Sticky sauce. Remove the chicken then add Bok choy sliced lengthways to the pan and cook for 1 minute just to get a nice char. 

Fill a small bowl with sticky rice and tip it upside down to create a nice rice dome in the bottom of the bowl. Spoon over the broth,
Top the the sliced chicken, bak choy, sliced spring onion, crispy onion"

Owen Han on Instagram: "Steak Ramen 🍜 

INGREDIENTS ⬇️

Soy Marinated Eggs
* 4 soft-boiled eggs (6½ minutes, ice bath)
* 1 cup soy sauce
* ½ cup water
* 2 tbsp mirin
Gochujang Compound Butter
* 4 tbsp softened butter
* 1 tbsp gochujang
* 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
* 1 green onion, very thinly sliced
* 1 ribeye
Ramen broth:
* 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
* 1-inch piece ginger, minced
* 1 tbsp laksa paste
* 1 tbsp miso paste
* 2 tsp soy sauce
* 2 tsp mirin
* ½ can coconut milk 
* 1–1½ cups chicken broth
* 2 tsp sugar
* Cornstarch slurry (1 tsp cornstarch + splash water)
* 1 portion ramen noodles
* garnishes: extra scallions, toasted sesame, nori"

Coconut Curry Basil Chicken. A simple, 30-minute creamy coconut chicken made with fresh basil and salted cashews. This one-skillet dinner is all about bold, vibrant flavor—think yellow curry powder, garlic, onions, spicy jalapeños, and creamy coconut milk. The chicken simmers with garden veggies and basil, and just before serving, a squeeze of lime brings it all to life. Spoon it over rice (to soak up all that saucy goodness), add your favorite flatbread, and dinner’s done. So easy, so delicious.

After spending a few days back in Ohio, it was clear to me that temperatures are HOT in most areas of the US and Europe too! Which means I’m avoiding the oven and sticking to stovetop cooking—or even better, the crockpot.

My dad used to make similar dishes, usually in the form of an Asian-style stir-fry. But I love the richness coconut milk adds—it gives the sauce a silky creaminess that’s perfect over rice. Let it soak in… it’s the best part.
My brothers go crazy for this one. I always add a little extra black pepper just for them—they love a good peppery kick.
Just a skillet for this recipe with the addition of a great knife , cutting board , and if mixing your own spice blend, a jar or bowl.
